body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Lexmark introduced its 3-in-1 inkjet printer 'Interact S605' with a 4.3" web-enabled LCD touchscreen during CES Unveiled at CES 2010. Suggested price is $199.99.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
